newsitem.title: UK: Dixons sells 40 pct in Link to Cellnet.
newsitem.headline: Dixons sells 40 pct in Link to Cellnet.

text.p: British retailer Dixons Group Plc said on Tuesday that it had sold a 40 percent of its control in Link, its mobile phone business, to Telecom Securicor Cellular Radio Ltd (Cellnet).

Dixons said Cellnet would pay an initial cash consideration of 25 million stg with further cash payments of up to 32 million stg depending on the performance and expansion of Link over the next five years.
Dixons said the transaction would translate into a 19 million stg gain for the group in its results for the 53 weeks to May 1997.
The Link, established in 1994, specialises in sale of mobile phones, fixed line telephones, faxes, pagers, personal organisers and a range of British Telecom services.
The Link's turnover in the year to April 27, 1996 stood at 21 million stg when it reported a net loss before tax of 2.9 million stg. Its net assets were valued at 7.5 million stg.
The firm currently operates 87 stores, mainly in the south east of England and plans to expand throughout the UK to over 200 stores.
